resolvedFinding.issue: Parent contextMenu state could survive selection/query changes and reopen a stale menu after a new selection
resolvedFinding.resolution: The parent records the same selection identity, including album scope, and clears context state during render when identity differs or selected count reaches zero; the menu key uses that identity
resolvedFinding.regressionCoverage: The mandatory feedback phase opens a menu, changes query using browser Back, then selects a checkbox and asserts that no stale menu reappears

reviewConclusions: Pointer contextmenu and Shift+F10/ContextMenu keys call the same openContextMenu helper and retain the same selection semantics and origin focus
A deliberate photo drag suppresses the React Aria onPress detail callback; a subsequent primary pointer press or Enter/Space resets suppression
Existing Air selection lifecycle and cancellation remain in use rather than introducing another drag engine
Thumbnail dimensions come from the stored thumbnail version in the existing batched read; list and status share the contract, and original image dimensions retain their original meaning
Missing, partial and non-stored thumbnail dimensions are covered by query integration tests; rotated thumbnail proportions are covered by layout and existing media orientation tests
Four rounded corners and grid crop versus masonry full proportion are explicitly recorded in the approved handoff amendment
The feedback phase is awaited by the full runner and cleans its temporary thumbnail objects, version records and files
verifyLibraryContextEdges is called by the mandatory feedback helper and asserts main boundaries, action target sizes and Escape origin focus in both themes
